description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ihala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420501 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, owner details, and property characteristics) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
